_doc: Code component <-> Figma node, and the running record of what has been reconciled. `componentKey` stays null until the source file is published as a library; until then the join is pageId + componentSetId, both of which are file-local and refreshable. A component absent from this map has no Figma representation yet — the absence is the signal, so add an entry when the work is done, never in advance.

Tabs.note: A plain COMPONENT, not a set: the code component has no variant axes (contract axes: null). Selection lives here at runtime as value/defaultValue/onValueChange, which is not a thing a frame can switch on. Holds three TabItem INSTANCES that grow equally, reproducing the mock where three tabs fill a 452px row. The track is a bottom stroke on the list part; its 1px weight is a LITERAL because Figma will not bind strokeWeight. DOCUMENTED 2026-08-29 (ds-figma-document): frame 'Tabs doc' carries title, three-paragraph description, the component, the code API table and a baked-values note. No cell grid, deliberately - the component has no variant axis, so a grid would imply a choice that does not exist. Two Figma annotations on the component: Interaction (why there is no axis) and Development (the baked 1px track).

TabItem.note: DELIBERATE DEVIATION from this schema's agreement rule, recorded rather than hidden. The schema says axes must agree with the component's extracted prop value sets; TabItem HAS no prop value sets (contract axes: null), so neither Figma axis maps to a prop. Both are design-only. Selected is derived in code by comparing this item's value against the selection on Tabs — there is deliberately no selected prop (ADR 0006), which is what makes two selected tabs unwritable. State is the browser's: hover is :hover, focus is :focus-visible, pressed is :active. Only disabled corresponds to a real prop. Do not 'fix' this by adding props to the component. DOCUMENTED 2026-08-29 (ds-figma-document): frame 'TabItem doc' carries title, three-paragraph description, the component, a GROUP holding the set overlaid on a 5x2 dashed cell grid with purple axis labels, the code API table and a baked-values note. Cells are 200x120, whole pixels, strokeAlign CENTER. No extension table: the set already models every state, so a table would only repeat it. Two Figma annotations on the set: Interaction (neither axis is a prop) and Development (the two baked values).

TabPanel.note: A plain COMPONENT: no axes in code, and no visible state to switch — the panel is shown or removed with the hidden attribute, never faded. Its only bound paint is the space above it (space/5). The dashed box inside is a SLOT PLACEHOLDER for the consumer's content and is not part of the contract anatomy. DOCUMENTED 2026-08-29 (ds-figma-document): frame 'TabPanel doc' carries title, three-paragraph description, the component and the code API table. No cell grid and no state axis - the panel is present or removed with the hidden attribute, never faded, so there is nothing to show. Two Figma annotations: Content (the slot placeholder) and Interaction (hidden, not faded).

Icon.note: RECORDED FROM A READ, NOT GENERATED — this set was drawn in Figma and transcribed into code, so generatedAt is null. TWO DISAGREEMENTS WITH CODE, both deliberate and both outstanding on the Figma side. (1) CASE: the 52 values above are snake_case as they stand in the file; ADR 0005 makes the code values kebab-case, so every value here must be renamed before the exact-match rule in manifest.json holds. (2) COUNT: 52 here against 50 in code — ADR 0004 drops graphic_eq_active and close_small_danger as pure recolours of graphic_eq and close_small. Nothing gates either disagreement; see the manifest _gatedNote.
